newsitem.title: JAPAN: Isuzu launches new bus series in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Isuzu launches new bus series in Japan.

text.p: Isuzu Motors Ltd announced on Wednesday the launch in Japan of new series of heavy luxury buses called the "Gala" as a successor to its LV series.
"The new Gala buses feature safety and high reliability. We hope to activate the slow domestic bus market with this new Gala series," Isuzu president Kazuhira Seki told reporters.
Isuzu, owned 37.4 percent by General Motors Corp, hopes to sell 350 units per year.
Domestic prices will start at 29.67 million yen.
The new buses meet Europe's ECE R-66 standard for structural strength and ability to withstand rollovers and have an anti-lock braking system, an Isuzu official said.
Isuzu has no definite plans to export the new buses.
Japan's heavy bus market totals about 1,400 units per year and Isuzu holds a 12.5 percent share, an Isuzu official said.
